sources.institution: Lehmann, E.L., & Romano, J.P. (2005). Testing Statistical Hypotheses (3rd ed.)

sources.institution: Casella, G., & Berger, R.L. (2002). Statistical Inference (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Core theoretical reference for likelihood ratio tests, Wilks' theorem, power functions, and confidence set duality
Foundational mathematical formulation of the Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT), OC curves, and ASN functions

sources.institution: Gibbons, J.D., & Chakraborti, S. (2020). Nonparametric Statistical Inference (6th ed.)
sources.role: Comprehensive reference for empirical distribution tests, Wilcoxon, Mann-Whitney, Kruskal-Wallis, Friedman, and rank correlation
